The solutions in the project have been considered and approved by the National Assembly and competent authorities. Under the project, Vietnam Airlines has implemented and will continue to implement three (3) solutions to overcome the current financial situation including:"}, {"bbox": [123, 362, 354, 376], "category": "List-item", "text": "- Enhance air transport business results;"}, {"bbox": [123, 385, 667, 414], "category": "List-item", "text": "- Implement asset restructuring and divest from subsidiaries and associates to increase income and cash flow; and"}, {"bbox": [123, 423, 667, 452], "category": "List-item", "text": "- Prepare necessary conditions to implement the plan to issue shares to increase share capital phase 02 in accordance with Resolution No. 174/2024/QH-15 dated 30 November 2024."}, {"bbox": [123, 468, 667, 558], "category": "Text", "text": "The Board of Executive Officers has carefully assessed the business and cash flow plans, as well as the ability to balance cash flows to pay off due debts and financial obligations as well as the loans and capital support from the Government and the ability to implement restructuring plans and address difficulties of Vietnam Airlines for the period up to 2035. The Board of Executive Officers believes that it is appropriate to have the accompanying consolidated financial statements prepared on a going concern basis."}, {"bbox": [123, 573, 205, 587], "category": "Section-header", "text": "### Financial year"}, {"bbox": [123, 602, 546, 617], "category": "Text", "text": "Vietnam Airlines' financial year begins on 01 January and ends on 31 December."}, {"bbox": [611, 568, 641, 672], "category": "Picture"}, {"bbox": [80, 637, 351, 651], "category": "Section-header", "text": "## 3. NEW ACCOUNTING GUIDANCE IN ISSUE"}, {"bbox": [123, 666, 667, 727], "category": "Text", "text": "On 27 October 2025, the Ministry of Finance issued Circular No. 99/2025/TT-BTC (\"Circular 99\") guiding the application of accounting regime for enterprises. Circular 99 is effective from 01 January 2026 and applies for financial years beginning on or after 01 January 2026. This Circular will supersede the following regulations:"}, {"bbox": [123, 742, 667, 787], "category": "Text", "text": "- Circular No. 200/2014/TT-BTC dated 22 December 2014 of the Ministry of Finance (\"Circular 200\") providing guidance on the corporate accounting regime (except for contents relating to accounting guidance for the equitization of State-owned enterprises)."}, {"bbox": [123, 787, 667, 816], "category": "Text", "text": "- Circular No. 75/2015/TT-BTC dated 18 May 2015 of the Ministry of Finance on amendments to Article 128 of Circular 200,"}, {"bbox": [123, 816, 667, 846], "category": "Text", "text": "- Circular No. 53/2016/TT-BTC dated 21 March 2016 of the Ministry of Finance amending and adding some articles of Circular 200, and"}, {"bbox": [123, 846, 667, 877], "category": "Text", "text": "- Circular No. 195/2012/TT-BTC dated 15 November 2012 of the Ministry of Finance providing accounting guidance for investors."}, {"bbox": [123, 892, 667, 937], "category": "Text", "text": "The Board of Executive Officers is considering the extent of impact of the adoption of Circular 99 on the Company's consolidated financial statements for future accounting periods, beginning on or after 01 January 2026."}, {"bbox": [368, 984, 383, 997], "category": "Page-footer", "text": "18"}]
